recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-15815 unless a new work-group issue changes the current mapping semantics.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 issue requesting mappings between DocumentReference and Composition when a DocumentReference describes a FHIR document, including document status, title/description, event/period/detail, identifier, type, subject, author, attester, custodian, relatesTo, security label, content, and profile-derived rows.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-15815 was found. The current source has reciprocal mapping identities and element rows for FHIR DocumentReference and FHIR Composition; later HL7/fhir#2862 / commit 0567b321121d035aeefc71f3508017e34d7efdbb updated the Composition/DocumentReference mapping family after resource refactors.
additional_context: Composition and DocumentReference are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR versions renamed or refactored several STU3-era elements, including masterIdentifier to identifier, class to category, agent to author, authenticator to attester, and context child fields to current context/event/period/related fields. Later same-family FHIR-37443 is already represented on the combined branch by 27012cf35cd50ac3789e5b1a3d8c1042d7d1d3d9, and FHIR-37549 separately supports the current DocumentReference.event mapping context. No direct Zulip or Confluence references to FHIR-15815 were found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current combined branch already contains the bidirectional Composition/DocumentReference mappings requested by FHIR-15815, with current element names and later accepted corrections.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue requiring Composition mappings to mirror DocumentReference mappings; already represented on the combined branch, so no duplicate commit was published here.
Separate O&O issue confirming DocumentReference.event mapping context; cited as context but not decided in this seed audit.
